description:
The Lion does not DMod

Turns the Special Modification into a plain BuiltIn-Mod

True Believers in the Supreme Executors Vision know the length outside threats and terrorist would ge to undermine HIS SUPREME AUHTORITY over the Persian Sector.

The newest strike in a long list of slights against the Sindrian Diktat is the labeling of the Special-Modifications of HIS Vision and Design as defective, damaged, degraded....

THIS SLIGHT STANDS NO LONGER. BY HIS COMMAND all loyal Subjects will Update their Tri-Tech Data-Pads to now show that HIS Design is no DMOD!
